Cash Flow Type.description: Initial investment, Follow-on, Dividend recapitalisation, Partial realisation.

Company.description: Portfolio company (shared master; every fact joins here).

Fund.description: Northstar fund holding the investment (NCP IV, NEF II, NCP V, NCP VI).

Initiative Status.description: Proposed → Under Review → Approved → In Progress → Completed → Benefits Verified.

Investment Stage.description: Value creation, Follow-on capital or Exit preparation.

Plan.description: Approved Forecast, Original Investment Case, Latest Budget, Downside Case, Value Creation Case or an approved operating plan.

Quarter.description: Reporting quarter (YYYY-Qn) of the monitoring financials.

Reporting Currency.description: Company reporting currency; facts are converted to USD at the Northstar Treasury quarter-end rate.

Risk Class.description: Standard, Elevated or High (leverage, coverage, underwriting variance).

Sector.description: Technology, Healthcare, Business Services, Industrials, Consumer, Financial Services.

Source System.description: Where the monitoring pack came from.

Statement.description: Income statement, Balance sheet or Cash flow statement.

Thesis Status.description: On track, At risk, Off track.

Workflow Period.description: Reporting period of the workflow record.

Workflow Type.description: Monitoring, Valuation, Scenario, Initiative, IC Package, Action, Finding, Saved View.

Benefit Realisation.description: Realised ÷ planned EBITDA impact to date.

Bridge FX.description: Translation at the quarter-end Northstar Treasury rate.

Bridge Multiple.description: Change in multiple × current metric × ownership.

Bridge Net Debt.description: Change in net debt and senior claims (excluding capital events) × ownership.

Bridge Operating Performance.description: Change in LTM metric × prior multiple × ownership.

Bridge Ownership.description: Change in economic ownership × equity value.

Budget Variance.description: Revenue vs budget (%), recomputed from sums.

Cash Conversion Change.description: Cash conversion now − a year ago (points).

Cash Conversion PY.description: Prior LTM FCF ÷ prior LTM EBITDA.

Change in Working Capital.description: Increase in net working capital (cash outflow).

EBITDA.description: Reported EBITDA = gross profit − personnel − other opex.

EBITDA Margin.description: Σ EBITDA ÷ Σ revenue (recomputed, never averaged).

EBITDA Margin PLTM.description: Prior LTM EBITDA ÷ prior LTM revenue.

EBITDA vs Underwriting.description: LTM EBITDA vs original investment case (%).

EV / EBITDA.description: Σ EV ÷ Σ LTM EBITDA for EV/EBITDA marks (weighted, approved).

Equity Value.description: Approved equity value (100%) = EV − net debt − senior claims + non-operating assets.

Estimated EBITDA Impact.description: Run-rate EBITDA impact in the business case.

Fair Value.description: Approved fair value: latest approved valuation per investment (USD $m).

Fair Value Impact of -1.0x.description: Fair value change if the valuation multiple contracted by 1.0x (−LTM EBITDA × ownership), EV/EBITDA marks.

Fair Value at Quarter.description: Fair value of the valuation rows in context (use with Valuation Quarter).

Free Cash Flow.description: Levered FCF = operating cash flow − capex.

Fund Gross IRR.description: Pooled fund gross IRR at Q3 2026 (fund grain only).

Fund NAV.description: Fund NAV at Q3 2026 (all valuation rows, incl. proposals).

Gross IRR.description: Gross IRR from dated cash flows and the approved fair value (company grain only: IRRs are never summed or averaged).

Gross MOIC.description: (Realised + unrealised) ÷ invested, recomputed at any grain.

Interest Coverage +100bp.description: LTM EBITDA ÷ (LTM interest + 1% × floating-rate drawn debt).

Interest Coverage PY.description: Prior LTM EBITDA ÷ prior LTM interest.

Invested Capital.description: Initial and follow-on investment (dated cash flows).

Line Order.description: Presentation order of the statement line.

Mix Effect.description: Revenue change vs same quarter last year from product / customer mix.

Monthly Revenue.description: Monthly revenue (operating KPI feed, reconciles to quarterly revenue).

Net Debt.description: Net debt at Q3 2026 (snapshot, never summed over time).

Net Leverage Change.description: Net leverage now − a year ago (turns).

Non-recurring Items.description: Non-recurring costs added back in Adjusted EBITDA.

Operating Cash Flow.description: EBITDA − interest − tax − Δ working capital.

Price Effect.description: Revenue change vs same quarter last year from pricing.

Prior Fair Value.description: Fair value one quarter before the current approved mark.

Q3 Valuation Movement.description: Q3 2026 movement in the proposal, net of capital flows.

Realised EBITDA Impact.description: EBITDA impact realised to date (verified by portfolio operations).

Revenue.description: Revenue summed over the quarters in context (USD $m).

Revenue LTM.description: Last twelve months to the latest quarter (Q4 2025 – Q3 2026).

Revenue PY Same Quarter.description: Revenue in the same quarter of the prior year.

Revenue vs Underwriting.description: LTM revenue vs original investment case (%).

Statement Amount.description: Financial statement line amount (sign as presented).

Thesis Score.description: Average status score (2 on track, 1 at risk, 0 off track).

Unrealised Value.description: Approved fair value of the remaining holding.

Valuation Movement.description: Approved fair value change in the quarter, net of contributions and distributions.

Valuation Multiple.description: Multiple applied in the valuation row (company grain only).

Volume Effect.description: Revenue change vs same quarter last year from volume.
